# kargo-crds

<!-- GENERATED by tooling/crdgen. Do not edit. -->

CustomResourceDefinitions for Kargo (Projects, Warehouses, Freight, Stages, Promotions).

CRDs are copied verbatim from [akuity/kargo](https://github.com/akuity/kargo)
at tag [`v1.12.5`](https://github.com/akuity/kargo/tree/v1.12.5) (commit `f9623d8e8415f4c4d18feefc4aa532bdeb173cc0`),
path(s) `charts/kargo/resources/crds`, and rendered as regular Helm templates so that
`helm upgrade` updates them (Helm's own `crds/` directory never upgrades).

## Install

```sh
helm install kargo oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/kargo-crds --version <version>
```

Chart `version` equals the upstream version it ships; `appVersion` is always the exact upstream version.
Installing requires Kubernetes >=1.25.0.

### Already have these CRDs?

If the CRDs were installed by the operator chart or `kubectl apply`, Helm refuses with
"rendered manifests contain a resource that already exists". Either let Helm adopt them:

```sh
helm install kargo oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/kargo-crds --version <version> --take-ownership   # Helm >= 3.17
```

or, on older Helm, hand them over first (replace `<release>` and `<namespace>`):

```sh
kubectl annotate crd clusterconfigs.kargo.akuity.io clusterpromotiontasks.kargo.akuity.io freights.kargo.akuity.io projectconfigs.kargo.akuity.io projects.kargo.akuity.io promotionrequests.kargo.akuity.io promotions.kargo.akuity.io promotiontasks.kargo.akuity.io stages.kargo.akuity.io targets.kargo.akuity.io warehouses.kargo.akuity.io \
  meta.helm.sh/release-name=<release> meta.helm.sh/release-namespace=<namespace> --overwrite
kubectl label crd clusterconfigs.kargo.akuity.io clusterpromotiontasks.kargo.akuity.io freights.kargo.akuity.io projectconfigs.kargo.akuity.io projects.kargo.akuity.io promotionrequests.kargo.akuity.io promotions.kargo.akuity.io promotiontasks.kargo.akuity.io stages.kargo.akuity.io targets.kargo.akuity.io warehouses.kargo.akuity.io \
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm --overwrite
```

## Values

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| `annotations` | object | `{}` | Extra annotations added to every CRD. |
| `labels` | object | `{}` | Extra labels added to every CRD. |
| `keepOnUninstall` | bool | `true` | Add `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep` so CRDs (and all their custom resources) survive `helm uninstall`. |

Unknown keys are rejected (`values.schema.json`).
